nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Following the detection of three Human Metapneumovirus (#HMPV) cases in India, #AIIMS #Bhopal has introduced RT-PCR testing facilities to enhance early detection. 
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov #India

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠The hospital has also prepared isolation wards, general beds, and ventilator-equipped #ICU beds for critical cases. 
Officials confirmed that the facility is fully equipped with advanced resources and an experienced team to manage potential emergencies.
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Madhya Pradesh’s Deputy Chief Minister, Rajendra Shukla, has directed the health department to ramp up virus monitoring efforts across the state. 
#AIIMS Bhopal has issued public guidelines emphasizing early detection, preventive measures, and awareness to mitigate the virus’s spread.
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov #India

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Madhya Pradesh is taking proactive steps to monitor and manage #HMPV, with #AIIMS Bhopal serving as a key hub for testing and treatment. 
Public health officials encourage vigilance and adherence to hygiene practices to prevent further cases. 
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov #India
